recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and satin-lapel blazer against a stark white background, featuring a horizontal typographic bar that intersects the subject's torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark attire against a pure white void
Text block anchored to the left edge, overlapping the subject
Direct eye contact creating a focal point in the upper third
Satin textures of the suit contrasting with the matte felt of the hat
coreInvariants: Horizontal text alignment across the mid-section

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject slightly off-center to the right, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the brim of the black cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the bold text on the left, then following the horizontal line of the subtitle across the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left and top, creating a clean, airy feel despite the dark subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the suit and hat to create a sharp silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural warm skin tones and subtle brown chest hair for organic texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the #000000 subject and #FFFFFF background; low saturation overall.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning for the primary name
Wide tracking for the secondary title

treatment.fill: white or black depending on background overlap

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the subject's torso area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weight and tracking within the same sans-serif family to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed display feel of the primary name.
Provides a clean, readable subtitle with a similar grotesque skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a goatee wearing a black cowboy hat and a black satin-lapel blazer over an open-collar black shirt. The background must be pure, solid white. Lighting should be bright and even, highlighting the texture of the clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a bold, extra-condensed sans-serif font on the left, half-overlapping the blazer. Add the album title in a smaller, regular-weight condensed sans-serif with wide tracking to the right of the name, rendered in white.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without shadows?
Does the text align horizontally across the middle of the image?
Is the primary name significantly bolder than the subtitle?

adjustableVariables: Specific texture of the blazer (satin vs. matte)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Unique facial features of the original person
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cowboy hat brim does not cast a shadow that obscures the eyes.
Verify the white text is legible against the black clothing.
Check that the subject is cropped at the waist.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key White Background + Black Formal Western Wear + Left-Anchored Condensed Sans-Serif Typography.
